Operations Coordinator
Northgate Logistics Partners, Columbus, OH (hybrid, 3 days on site)

About the role
Northgate is a growing third-party logistics provider serving retail and consumer goods brands. The Operations Coordinator keeps our warehouse and transportation teams moving. You will be the glue between the floor, our carriers, and our account managers. We're looking for a self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced environment and can wear many hats.

What you'll do
- Coordinate daily inbound and outbound shipment schedules with carriers and warehouse leads
- Track KPIs (on-time shipping, order accuracy, dock-to-stock time) and prepare weekly reports for leadership
- Maintain SOPs and help roll out process improvements across two sites
- Support inventory reconciliation and resolve discrepancies with clients
- Act as a point of contact for client escalations and own them to resolution
- Assist with onboarding new clients, including setting up item masters in the WMS

Requirements
- 2+ years of experience in operations, logistics, supply chain, or a related field
- Bachelor's degree in business, supply chain, or related field, or equivalent experience
- Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP)
- Experience with a warehouse management system (WMS) such as Manhattan, Blue Yonder, or similar
- Strong communication skills and attention to detail
- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

Preferred qualifications
- Experience with a transportation management system (TMS)
- Lean or Six Sigma Yellow Belt
- Experience with Power BI or Tableau
- Familiarity with EDI transactions

Compensation: $58,000 - $66,000 per year, plus annual bonus up to 5%. Full benefits.
